verdict.rationale: RunAnywhere is an on-device and hosted AI inference SDK and CLI, so a buyer could fairly ask whether it supports background automations. The evidence never documents scheduled, recurring or autonomous background jobs. The SDK's tool-calling loop and the voice agent are developer building blocks or interactive sessions, not automations a user configures to run unattended.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
